intro: Our Adria bedside table is designed for the rhythm of everyday life—balancing smart storage, durable finishes, and thoughtful detailing to bring ease and reliability into your bedroom.

features.title: Built for unwavering stability
features.text: Our metal frame reinforces the table’s structure, so it stays steady and secure, no matter how your day stacks up.

features.title: We protect what matters
features.text: Our design is made with high-grade 18mm prelaminated particle board, finished with melamine to resist moisture and keep your essentials safe.

features.title: Hardware that won’t let you down
features.text: We use trusted components—rollers, hinges, and dowels—ensuring smooth operation and lasting quality.

features.title: Guarded against life’s messes
features.text: Every exposed edge is sealed with 0.8mm PVC banding to protect against moisture, spills, and wear—because life happens.

features.title: We make moving simpler
features.text: Our knockdown design ensures the table is easy to assemble, disassemble, and shift as your home evolves.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
